messages:
maya: Hey sec team — need short-lived read-only access to pull app logs from prod-west for a GDPR sample and a crash trace. Want to run: `kubectl -n payments logs -l app=processor --since=24h` and collect redacted lines. Need ~2h. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGOPS-4123. Any objections?

raquel: Can you confirm exact cluster/namespace, scope (labels ok), reason, and TTL? Also will PII be included? We need to ensure redaction before export.

owen: FWIW, instead of granting a persistent role, we can spin up an ephemeral SSM bastion session and let you run the command from there — avoids copying logs out. Thoughts?

maya: cluster: prod-west-1, namespace: payments, labels: app=processor. Reason: reproduce user-reported payment failures, need stack traces for 3 users (IDs linked in the ticket). PII may appear; plan is to run a jq filter and then `sed -E 's/"card_number":"[0-9]+"/"card_number":"REDACTED"/'` before storing. TTL: 2 hours starting now.

owen: Sounds good — ephemeral session preferred. That way we can deny `kubectl exec` and prevent downloads.

maya: Ephemeral SSM works for me. If sec agrees, I just need the bastion role `bastion-logs` with `kubectl logs` rights in `payments` ns.

access-bot: New access request created: ARC-98765. Approvers required: raquel, jules. Link: https://access.redwood.io/requests/ARC-98765 :lock:

jules: Approved for 2 hours. :white_check_mark: Please ensure only redacted results get uploaded to S3 with `redact=true` tag and delete any local copies after.

raquel: Approved as well. I'll issue an ephemeral SSM session and attach a session policy that limits `kubectl logs` to the `payments` namespace and explicitly denies `kubectl exec`/`attach`. I'll log the audit event and TTL is 2h. :shield:

access-bot: Session started for maya via SSM at 1999991248. Session ID: ssm-0a1b2c3d. Audit: https://audit.redwood.io/events/EV-5555

maya: Got it — running the command now. I'll paste the redacted sample back into ENGOPS-4123 and delete my temp copy when done. Thanks :pray:

access-bot: Session ended at 1999991305. ARC-98765 set to closed.
